one_line: Omnichannel help desk and live chat platform with ticketing, knowledge base, social, and call center capabilities.
auth_notes: REST API (v4) authenticated with API keys generated in the LiveAgent admin panel; no OAuth flow.
self_serve_notes: 30-day free trial, then paid plans; API keys available to any account during trial. Docs/portal require login.

api_surface.breadth_estimate: Tickets, agents, departments, users, conversations, calls, and related entities; tens of endpoints in API v4.
api_surface.webhook_note: Webhooks supported in API v4 for ticket/conversation events.

existing_mcp.note: No official MCP server located; any community servers unverified.
